migrations.name: kv
statements:
CREATE TABLE placement(
    one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1),
    shards INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (shards BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    shard INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (shard >= 0 AND shard < shards)
  )

CREATE TABLE kv(
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1),
    live INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (live IN (0, 1)),
    CHECK (live = 1 OR value = '')
  ) WITHOUT ROWID

queries: SELECT count(*) AS keys, coalesce(sum(live), 0) AS live FROM kv
INSERT INTO placement(one, shard, shards) VALUES (1, ?1, ?2) ON CONFLICT(one) DO UPDATE SET one = 1 RETURNING shard, shards
SELECT key, status, version FROM ops WHERE op = ?1
INSERT INTO kv(key, value, version, live) VALUES (?1, ?2, 1, 1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value, version = version + 1, live = 1 RETURNING key, value, version, live
INSERT INTO kv(key, value, version, live) VALUES (?1, ?2, 1, 1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key, value, version, live
UPDATE kv SET value = ?1, version = version + 1, live = 1 WHERE key = ?2 AND version = ?3 RETURNING key, value, version, live
UPDATE kv SET value = '', version = version + 1, live = 0 WHERE key = ?1 AND live = 1 RETURNING key, value, version, live
UPDATE kv SET value = '', version = version + 1, live = 0 WHERE key = ?1 AND live = 1 AND version = ?2 RETURNING key, value, version, live
SELECT key, value, version, live FROM kv WHERE key = ?1
INSERT INTO ops(op, key, status, version) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4) RETURNING op
